test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct option that indicates the arrangement of following units in a logical and meaningful order.

1. Byte

2. Megabyte

3. Terabyte

4. Gigabyte

5. Kilobyte
solution:
**__Logic__: **Arranged in ascending order.

**Byte [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**Byte - 8 bits

Kilobyte (KB) - 1024 bytes

Megabyte (MB) - 1024 Kilobytes (KB)

Gigabyte (GB) - 1024 Megabytes (MB)

Terabyte (TB) - 1024 Gigabytes (GB)
